description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

USAble Life is hiring Web Developer I/II professionals to develop, maintain, test, and improve software applications supporting its business systems. The role involves translating business requirements into technical solutions and contributing to application development, quality assurance, deployment, and code reviews.
Web Developer I developing and maintaining software applications for company systems, supporting integration requirements, testing releases, and reviewing code

Responsibilities:
• Work with Business Analysts and Lead Developers to identify and document business requirements related to system integrations
• Analyze system specifications and determine appropriate technical solutions
• Develop, implement, maintain, and test software applications that support company systems
• Recommend practical solutions to processing problems and system requirements
• Support quality assurance, testing, and software deployment activities
• Participate in application planning, design, development, and deployment
• Contribute to code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and learn established software development practices
• Review code to ensure compliance with coding standards, conventions, and consistency across applications
• Communicate work status and progress to development and project teams
• Help deliver projects in a timely and cost-effective manner
• Perform other related duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Information Systems, with coursework and/or experience aligned with the required technical skills, or equivalent military experience for Web Developer I
• Minimum of 1 year of IT experience for Web Developer I
• Minimum of 2 years of IT experience for Web Developer II
• Experience with open-source tools such as log4net, NUnit, and NHibernate
• Experience using version control systems such as Git
• Experience writing SQL queries for databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or Oracle
• Experience with software development or release-tracking tools such as JIRA or Targetprocess
• Strong understanding of programming concepts, object-oriented programming, secure coding, and design patterns
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Strong attention to detail and excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to complete assigned tasks within established timelines
• Understanding of testing tools, unit testing, integration testing, test scripting, and testing methodologies

Preferred:
• For Web Developer I, preferred qualifications include coursework or a curriculum focused on SQL and Microsoft .NET
• at least 2 years of IT experience
• experience in the health insurance industry
• For Web Developer II, preferred qualifications include experience with continuous integration and delivery pipelines
• at least 3 years of IT experience
